name: Wolfgang von Trips
features: fair skin, blond hair swept back, pale blue eyes, long narrow face, aquiline nose, tall slim build, courteous aristocratic bearing
bio: Count Wolfgang von Trips, 'Taffy' to the paddock, raced out of a moated Rhineland castle and was the first German with a real chance of the world championship. He won the Dutch and British Grands Prix in 1961 and led the title race to Monza, where a collision with Jim Clark took him and fifteen spectators — the worst accident Formula One has known. He was declared runner-up posthumously.
